title.narrative: Strengthening Results-Based M&E for the Rural Development Strategy

description.narrative: " This project is aimed at strengthening the capacity of the SE-SDR, the committee composed of the DEP/DS* (Direction des Etudes et des Programmes and Direction des Statistiques) of the four ministries involved in the rural sector, and their operational units, to design and apply a results-based M&E system. The following outcomes are expected to be achieved at the end of the project "" Res.-1. Staff from targeted institutions have build required capacity in results - based M&E "" Res.-2. A Management Information System (MIS)and data collection formats are in place and able to provide detailed micro-data of good quality "" Res.-3. A results-based monitoring and evaluation system has been developed and implemented by competent rural sector institutions The Key Monitoring Indicators are as follows: "" Ind.-1.: Upon project completion, the M&E system of the RDS and related programs is functional "" Ind.-2.°: Upon project completion, at least 90% of all staff involved in the design and implementation of the RDS and related programs have been trained on results-based M&E "" Ind.-3.°: Upon project completion, a pool of resourceful results-based M&E specialists has been created within the rural sector. The project has the following components and sub components: 1. Building and sharing knowledge and technical skills in results-based M&E 1a. Assessing the RDS steering committee and operational units' needs and readiness to adopt a results-based M&E system. 1b. Elaborating a robust M&E log-frame including an accurate and concise definition of indicators, and articulated to a MIS and data collection mechanisms 1c. Elaborating a results-based M&E toolkit. 1d. Strengthening the capacity of the RDS Executive Secretariat and other stakeholders (e.g. Direction des Etudes et de la Programmation - DEP, Direction des Statistiques - DS and operational units) officials on results-based M&E. 2. Sustainably Implementing and scaling-up the RDS and related programs' results-based M&E system 2a. Choosing key parameters of the results-based M&E system for the RDS and related programs: 2b. Applying the RDS and related programs' newly developed results-based M&E system in a computerized environment This project is aimed at strengthening the capacity of the Rural Development Executive secretariat (SE-SDR), the committee composed of the Direction des Etudes et des Programmes/Direction des Statistiques (DEP/DS) of the five ministries involved in the rural sector, and their operational units, to design and apply a results-based M&E system in order to (i) ensure a better articulation of the strategic orientation with operational programming and budgeting, (ii) more efficiently monitor the implementation process, (iii) better evaluate the contribution of the rural sector to economic growth, food insecurity and poverty reduction."
